data.name: Mohiboon
data.gender_notes: Mohiboon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who loves Allah and His Messenger (pbuh) and strives to follow their teachings. The name Mohiboon carries the meaning “Lover” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mohiboon usually hope their child will grow to embody lover and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes love and devotion to Allah and His Prophet (pbuh).
data.etymology: Mohiboon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohiboon total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: محبون
in_arabic.meaning: أحباء و محبين، ذوي مودة و حب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم محبون مشتق من الجذر 'ح-ب-ب' و يعني الأشخاص الذين يحبون و يودون الآخرين، و يحملون في قلوبهم مودة و حبا للناس، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق المودة و الحب الإلهي.

in_urdu.name: محبون
in_urdu.meaning: پیار کرنے والے، محبت کرنے والے، عاشقان
in_urdu.long_meaning: محبون نام عربی جڑ 'ح-ب-ب' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے پیار کرنے والے یا محبت کرنے والے۔ یہ نام ان شخصیات کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے دل میں محبت و مودت کے ساتھ جینے والے لوگوں کو مخاطب کرتے ہیں۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، یہ نام محبت و مودت کی خوبیوں کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मोहिबून
in_hindi.meaning: प्यार करने वाले, प्रेम करने वाले, आशिक़
in_hindi.long_meaning: मोहिबून नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ح-ب-ب' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रेम करने वाले या प्यार करने वाले। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जिनके हृदय में प्रेम और स्नेह होता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम प्रेम और स्नेह के गुणों को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: محبون
in_pashto.meaning: د مینې وړونکي، مینه والا، عاشقان
in_pashto.long_meaning: محبون نوم د عربی جڑ 'ح-ب-ب' څخه راوتلی دی، چې معنی یې د مینې کولو یا مینه والا دي. دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چي د دوی په زړونو کې مینه او موده وي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د مینې او مودت ځانګړتیاوې ښايي.

in_english.name: Mohiboon
in_english.meaning: Lovers, beloved ones, those who love and are loved
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mohiboon originates from the Arabic root 'ح-ب-ب' (ḥ-b-b), which conveys the meanings of love, affection, and endearment. In Islamic tradition, Mohiboon refers to individuals who embody love, compassion, and kindness. The name signifies a person who is cherished and admired, reflecting the spiritual significance of love and unity in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mohiboon" may not be widely recognized as a specific Islamic name outside of certain Muslim communities, however the essence of the name holds deep cultural significance within the Islamic tradition. The term "Mohib" in Islamic context refers to someone who holds love, affection, and devotion towards Allah and his Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). This is a highly valued virtue in Islamic culture, as the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) once said, "None of you will enter Jannah until he loves me. He (the Beloved) said: So much so that he loves me more than his father, his children, and all people." (Bukhari and Muslim) The name Mohiboon therefore represents an individual who embodies this quality of strong and profound love for Allah and his Messenger, making it a powerful symbol of devotion and commitment to Islamic values within Muslim communities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Mohiboon" holds immense spiritual significance as it is a constant reminder for the individual to nurture and foster a deep love and attachment to Allah and His Messenger (pbuh). This devotion is not just limited to words or sentiments but requires consistent actions in accordance with the teachings of Islam. By keeping this love alive in one's heart, the individual is able to develop a strong spiritual bond with the Creator and thus lead a life that is pleasing to Allah, ultimately striving towards attaining His mercy and blessings in the hereafter. Hence, the name Mohiboon is a beautiful and powerful reminder of the importance of love and devotion towards Allah in the spiritual journey of a Muslim.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lover" symbolizes One who loves Allah and His Messenger (pbuh) and strives to follow their teachings.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mohiboon serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lover.
